note: Assets are fetched into a cache outside tracked source (default ~/.cache/cuda-elastic/loom-private-assets, override with LOOM_PRIVATE_ASSET_CACHE). Private Loom files are fetched from the pinned commit with gh and are never committed here.

mlperf-tiny-ad01-int8-model.role: Model executed by the model-backed anomaly application (private Loom manifest cached input 'model').

mlperf-tiny-ad01-dataset.role: The 40-sample dataset the anomaly application cycles (private Loom manifest cached input 'smoke-dataset').

anomaly-upstream-expected-smoke.role: Reference only: upstream oracle bytes for dataset sample 0, used to cross-check the CPU oracle without running the smoke preset.

anomaly-upstream-expected-validation.role: Reference only: upstream oracle bytes for dataset samples 2 and 3 (2 warmup, 2 measured), used to cross-check the CPU oracle.

vecadd-product-operands.role: The cached operand fixture (two 64-byte operands) the batched vecadd product derives its records from.

vecadd-product-upstream-expected-smoke.role: Reference only: upstream oracle bytes for one sample, used to cross-check record 0 without running the smoke preset.
